title: Swimmer braves tanker attacks to expose Hormuz contamination
html:
Swimmer braves tanker attacks to expose Hormuz contamination

As tankers burned and explosions shook the Strait of Hormuz, endurance swimmer Lewis Pugh entered the water to expose another casualty of the US-Israeli war on Iran: marine life. He warns that oil pollution could take decades to clean up, long after the fighting ends.
summary: As tankers burned in Hormuz, swimmer Lewis Pugh exposed another casualty of the US-Israeli war on Iran: marine life.
